intro: San Francisco rewards walkers with steep views, waterfront paths, and dense neighbourhood food. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: BART is the fast regional metro; Muni Metro and buses cover the city.
Buy a Clipper card for BART, Muni, Caltrain, and ferries.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft are widely used.
Driving is slow and parking is costly; skip a rental car in town.
Walking is the best way to see neighbourhoods; hills are steep.
Ferries from the Ferry Building reach Sausalito, Tiburon, and Alcatraz.

golden-gate-bridge.name: Golden Gate Bridge
golden-gate-bridge.price_text: Free to walk or bike · toll only for southbound cars
golden-gate-bridge.hours: Open 24 hours · welcome center roughly 09:00–18:00, check on the day
golden-gate-bridge.tip: Walk the east sidewalk for bay views and city skyline. Bring a jacket; fog and wind arrive fast.

alcatraz.name: Alcatraz Island
alcatraz.price_text: ≈ USD 45–50 adult day tour, includes ferry; check on the day
alcatraz.hours: Day tours roughly 09:00–16:00 · some evening tours
alcatraz.tip: Book weeks ahead; tickets sell out. The included audio tour of the cellhouse is the highlight.

fishermans-wharf.name: Fisherman's Wharf
fishermans-wharf.price_text: Free to walk · food and attractions extra
fishermans-wharf.hours: Always open · shops and piers roughly 10:00–20:00
fishermans-wharf.tip: See the sea lions at Pier 39, then walk west to the quieter Hyde Street Pier.

painted-ladies.name: Painted Ladies
painted-ladies.tip: The classic photo is from Alamo Square park across the street. These are private homes, so view from outside.

palace-fine-arts.name: Palace of Fine Arts
palace-fine-arts.price_text: Free · lagoon and grounds open daily
palace-fine-arts.hours: Grounds open 24 hours · nearby attractions vary
palace-fine-arts.tip: Walk the lagoon for the best reflection of the rotunda. Good picnic stop near the bridge.

alcatraz-ferry.name: Alcatraz Island Ferry
alcatraz-ferry.price_text: Included in Alcatraz tour ticket, ≈ USD 45–50; check on the day
alcatraz-ferry.hours: Departures from Pier 33 through the day · check schedule
alcatraz-ferry.tip: Arrive at Pier 33 about 30 minutes before departure; late arrivals are not held.

childrens-fairyland.name: Children's Fairyland
childrens-fairyland.price_text: ≈ USD 15 per person; check on the day
childrens-fairyland.hours: Usually Wed–Sun roughly 10:00–16:00 · check on the day
childrens-fairyland.tip: Aimed at young kids. Check the website for opening days before you go.

city-lights.name: City Lights Booksellers
city-lights.price_text: Free to browse · books for sale
city-lights.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
city-lights.tip: Climb to the poetry room upstairs. The Beat-era history is the draw.

bay-cruise.name: Golden Gate Bay Cruise
bay-cruise.price_text: ≈ USD 35–45 adult; check on the day
bay-cruise.tip: Sit on the open deck for bridge photos. It gets cold and windy on the water.

sf-bay.name: San Francisco Bay
sf-bay.price_text: Free to view · boat trips cost extra
sf-bay.tip: Best seen from a ferry, a waterfront walk or the bridge. Watch for fog rolling in.

flower-carrier.name: The Flower Carrier (Diego Rivera mural)
flower-carrier.price_text: ≈ USD 15–25 museum admission; check on the day
flower-carrier.hours: Museum hours vary; check on the day
flower-carrier.tip: This Rivera work hangs in a San Francisco museum. Confirm the current display and hours before visiting.

uc-berkeley.name: University of California, Berkeley (UC Berkeley)
uc-berkeley.price_text: Free to walk campus · some museums charge
uc-berkeley.tip: Walk to the Campanile tower for views. It is a BART ride from the city, so allow half a day.

ferry-building.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
ferry-building.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
ferry-building.hours: Roughly 10:00–18:00 daily · farmers market Tue/Thu/Sat mornings
ferry-building.tip: Come hungry for the Saturday farmers market. Many stalls close by late afternoon.

twin-peaks.name: Twin Peaks viewpoint
twin-peaks.tip: Drive or ride up for a full city view. It is windy and often foggy, so check the sky first.

cable-car.name: Historic cable car ride
cable-car.price_text: ≈ USD 8 per ride; day passes available, check on the day
cable-car.tip: Board at the Powell Street turnaround for a seat. Hang on outside for the classic ride.

chinatown-walk.name: Chinatown and Dragon's Gate walk
chinatown-walk.price_text: Free to walk · food and shops extra
chinatown-walk.tip: Enter at the Dragon's Gate on Grant Avenue and wander the side alleys for markets.

mission-murals.name: Mission District murals walk
mission-murals.tip: Start at Balmy Alley and Clara Street. Combine with a burrito nearby.

dolores-park.name: Mission Dolores Park
dolores-park.tip: Great city skyline view from the upper slope. Busy on sunny weekends.

union-square.name: Union Square
union-square.tip: Central shopping and transit hub. Good starting point for cable cars and Chinatown.

lands-end.name: Lands End coastal trail
lands-end.tip: Walk toward the Sutro Baths ruins for the best finish. Wear shoes with grip.

stays.why: Central for shopping, cable cars and transit; easy walk to Chinatown and the waterfront.
Steps from Alcatraz ferries, Pier 39 and the cable car; family-friendly but touristy.
Close to Oracle Park, museums and BART; good value and quick airport links.

food: Get a Mission-style burrito in the Mission District; portions are huge, so share or go hungry.
Ferry Building Marketplace: sample local cheese, bread and coffee; check opening days on the day.
Chinatown dim sum is cheap and filling; go before noon for the freshest trays.
Cioppino (seafood stew) and sourdough bread bowls are the classic wharf dishes; expect tourist prices.
Book popular restaurants ahead; walk-ins are hard at dinner on weekends.
more_time: Swap a city day for Muir Woods redwoods or Sausalito by ferry; check tour and shuttle options on the day.
Add a Golden Gate Park half-day: gardens, museums and Ocean Beach at the end.
Take a ferry to Alcatraz; tickets sell out, so book well ahead.
